711010101.text: Look, he really is over there!

711010104.text: We came to ask you about something!

711010105.text: Would you mind waiting for a moment? I'm currently in the middle of something.

711010107.text: Speaking of which, to think you managed to return so quickly... What speed!

711010108.text: Ah, Zhongli, are these your friends? They often come here to look for you.

711010109.text: Ah, yes. They are old acquaintances of mine.

711010110.text: Splendid. Since you two are also here, could you help me persuade Zhongli to sell his Archaic Stone, please?

711010111.text: Archaic Stone? What would you want one of those for?

711010112.text: Do you not know? Archaic Stone is highly sought-after now. It's not even a matter of price, for there is barely any supply on the market.

711010113.text: I was telling stories as usual today, and Zhongli dropped by as usual, too. Somehow we talked about my "Through the Eyes of a Dragon" — one of my finest works, if I do say so myself.

711010116.text: It's a good one, isn't it? Hehe, Zhongli also says that my storytelling is superb.

711010117.text: At first, I thought he was just an erudite gentleman who knew a lot about folk culture. But as it turns out, he's also well-versed in history and mythology. So, now I often trouble him with the various questions I've got.

711010119.text: Don't be so modest! You've helped me a lot! But come to think of it, the act of chatting is pleasurable only because you're talking to the right person. Zhongli, for instance, is a good chatting companion with many fantastic ideas and — to be honest — lots of far-fetched theories too, haha!

711010120.text: There was this one time when I told him, "See, my story first tells of how Rex Lapis carved Azhdaha out of a magical rock and then elaborates on how they fought side-by-side across the four corners of the world. Isn't that just mesmerizing?"

711010121.text: Yet he said: "The story is a true masterpiece save for some inaccurate details. According to some researchers, Rex Lapis may not have possessed the skills required to create such a work of craftsmanship."

711010123.text: What a bummer! And there was also another time when I told him about the serpent of Qingce Village. He didn't buy the story at all, saying it was too good to be true for the serpent to transform into a beautiful landscape.

711010124.text: Hmm, I wonder if too much knowledge can stifle imagination? What a shame that someone as well-cultured as Zhongli should fail to appreciate the aesthetics of artistic creation.

711010125.text: I can hardly object to your criticism. I shall keep it in mind.

711010126.text: But your stories are always marked by wild imaginations. I just point out what I notice as an ordinary listener and hope that it might be of use to you.

711010127.text: Since storytelling requires a sharp mind, I am sure a storyteller such as you can certainly understand where I'm coming from — those are the heartfelt reactions from a devoted audience member.

711010128.text: You're right! I know your good intentions. You want me to become the best storyteller in Liyue Harbor, right?
